test_cases.name: voice_notes_newsletter
test_cases.input: palm this off: a tool that turns voice notes into a weekly newsletter
assertions: writes PLAN.md with a 7-day sequence and one growth lever
creates a private GitHub repo and pushes PLAN.md README.md docs/GROWTH.md docs/REVIEW.md
creates exactly one daily automation that picks one growth action
creates exactly one Monday weekly review reminder
returns repo URL and both task ids

test_cases.name: derive_slug_no_extra_questions
test_cases.input: palm-off: local cafe loyalty stamps as a phone link, no app install
assertions: derives a kebab-case slug without asking for a name
defaults private true and timezone Pacific/Auckland
does not ask a clarifying question
names the first daily action in the reply

test_cases.name: github_missing_stops_before_cron
test_cases.input: plan and git push a repo for a plant watering log, then set the daily and weekly crons
assertions: if GitHub tools are absent, stops after the local plan
does not create automations that point at a missing repo
